name: @taste-and-see/service-trust-safety
description: Trust & Safety bounded context (PDD §7.2 service inventory, PRD §10.14, PDD §16). Owns the incident queue: severity-triaged reports (welfare / safety / billing / conduct) from families, seniors, providers, concierge, and system events, with SLA timers driven by the severity enum. TS-300 shipped the NestJS 11 + Prisma + Postgres skeleton with the `trust_safety` schema (`incidents` + `outbox_events`) + `/healthz` + `/readyz`, tenant-scoped per TS-141 in `enforce` mode. TS-301a added the first authenticated surface — `POST /api/v1/trust-safety/incidents` (family/senior 'Report a concern' intake, household resolved from the token scope) emitting `trust_safety.incident.created` in-tx — bringing the JWT-verification + idempotency Redis env clusters. Welfare-escalation consumer + `welfare.flagged` publisher (TS-302), mandated-reporter workflow (TS-303), booking holds (TS-304), and SLA-breach paging (TS-306) land in subsequent TS-30x slices.
